newsitem.title: INDIA: India L&T expects post-monsoon revival of business.
newsitem.headline: India L&T expects post-monsoon revival of business.

text.p: Indian engineering and construction group Larsen & Toubro said on Friday it expected business to revive after the monsoon ended.
"The company sees revival of business activity after the monsoon," the firm said in a statement shortly after its annual general meeting.
L&T based its forecast on a number of positive factors which it said had revived the economy.
Easy liquidity, lower interest rates, comfortable foreign exchange reserves and a growth-oreitned federal budget were the factors listed in the statement.
